blocks.text: Scientists hazaron qudrati ya synthetic compounds ko jaanchte (screen karte) hain taa ke woh maadde milen jo target molecule ke saath achhi tarah amal kar sakein. In umeed afza maaddon ko lead compounds kehte hain.
